skill.urskills.one_handed.desc: Swords, axes and other single-handed weapons. Levels by landing hits.
skill.urskills.two_handed.desc: Greatswords, battleaxes, warhammers and maces. Levels by landing hits.
skill.urskills.archery.desc: Bows and crossbows. Levels by hitting targets with arrows.
skill.urskills.block.desc: Turning blows aside with a shield. Levels by blocking attacks.
skill.urskills.heavy_armor.desc: Iron, steel and heavier plate. Levels by taking hits while wearing it.
skill.urskills.smithing.desc: Forging weapons and armor. Levels by smelting ingots, crafting gear and repairing.
skill.urskills.destruction.desc: Fire, frost and shock magic. Levels by damaging foes with spells.
skill.urskills.restoration.desc: Healing and warding magic. Levels by restoring health and warding.
skill.urskills.alteration.desc: Magic that shapes the world and the body. Levels by casting alteration spells.
skill.urskills.conjuration.desc: Summoning allies and bound weapons. Levels by conjuring.
skill.urskills.illusion.desc: Magic of the mind: calm, fear, invisibility. Levels by casting illusion spells.
skill.urskills.enchanting.desc: Imbuing gear with power. Levels by enchanting at tables and anvils.
skill.urskills.light_armor.desc: Leather, chain and other light armor. Levels by taking hits while wearing it.
skill.urskills.sneak.desc: Moving unseen. Levels by staying hidden near enemies and landing sneak attacks.
skill.urskills.lockpicking.desc: Getting into what is locked away. Levels by opening untouched chests.
skill.urskills.pickpocket.desc: Lifting coin and goods from the unwary. Levels by successful thefts.
skill.urskills.speech.desc: Haggling and persuasion. Levels by trading and talking your way through.
skill.urskills.alchemy.desc: Brewing potions. Levels by taking potions from a brewing stand.
skill.urskills.mining.desc: Breaking stone and ore. Levels by mining.
skill.urskills.woodcutting.desc: Felling trees. Levels by chopping logs.
skill.urskills.fishing.desc: Pulling fish (and stranger things) from the water.
skill.urskills.farming.desc: Crops and livestock. Levels by harvesting ripe crops and breeding animals.
skill.urskills.cooking.desc: Turning raw food into meals. Levels by cooking and preparing food.
skill.urskills.agility.desc: Running, climbing, swimming and surviving falls. Levels by moving.
